messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: routing.fallback.errors spiked in ap-southeast-1 (1825004321) — severity: P2. Symptoms: increased 5xx on failed fallbacks, customer-visible latency. Pager: oncall-sre.

Jules: I'm on it. seeing pages and dashboard spikes. tagging infra and platform. any immediate errors from the router?

Marco: grabbing proxy tail now, pasting top hits.
```
[2026-05-10T02:12:03Z] route=ap-southeast-1 req=xyz100 status=500 fallback=true model=rv-base-v1 reason=manifest-error
[2026-05-10T02:12:04Z] route=ap-southeast-1 req=xyz101 status=502 fallback=true model=alt-llm-8q reason=tokenizer-incompat
[2026-05-10T02:12:05Z] route=ap-southeast-1 req=xyz102 status=504 fallback=true model=rv-base-v1 reason=kvcache-timeout
```

Jules: tokenizer-incompat and manifest-error look actionable. Priya, are any recent fallback variants rolled out to ap-southeast-1?

Priya (platform): yes — alt-llm-8q was added to the fallback set last night as part of a staged rollout. I see it labeled `fallback_candidate=true` but there is a note that the manifest schema bumped tokenizer_version to 4. We expected compat v3.

Sara: that mismatch could explain the errors. If router routes to a model with unexpected tokenizer, model-host may reject requests at warmup or runtime.

Lena (devex): can we flip routing for that variant while we triage? We have the per-region disable flags: `policy.region_fallback.<region>.disable_variant` documented.

Priya: I'm applying `policy.region_fallback.ap-southeast-1.disable_variant=alt-llm-8q` now.

Priya: (12s later) flag applied. Telemetry: fallback traffic to alt-llm-8q -> 0. Errors drop ~75% within two minutes.

Jules: good. Marco, can you run a small replay against the healthy fallback (rv-base-v1) to confirm success rate? Use limited sample to avoid overload.

Marco: running router replay: POST /internal/replay filter(region=ap-southeast-1,fallback=true,limit=200) target=rv-base-v1

Marco: replay results: 196/200 successes, 4 timeouts (latency within normal SLO).

Jules: mitigation looks solid. Moving to collection mode. We need an in-thread RCA note with hypotheses and evidence. I'll capture and assign follow-ups.

-----
Hypotheses (initial):
- H1: alt-llm-8q manifest updated tokenizer_version=4 but routing/healthchecks assumed v3, causing runtime rejections.
- H2: rollout automation didn't enforce manifest compatibility gating for fallbacks.
- H3: healthprobe surface area doesn't cover tokenizer/manifest compatibility — only liveness and process checks.
- H4: selection weights allowed the new variant to receive traffic before config-store flagged readiness (race condition).

Evidence collected:
- router logs: `tokenizer-incompat` and `manifest-error` lines (see Marco paste).
- model-host logs: `ERR model-loader: manifest.schema.tokenizer_version=4 expected=3` and `WARN kvcache: prefix-warmup-failed` (link: https://internal.redwood/logs/incident/1825004321/host)
- config-store: fallback set includes alt-llm-8q with weight=0.25 in region ap-southeast-1 during window.
- telemetry: fallback_failure_rate peaked at 0.18 during 02:12–02:16Z, returned to baseline after disable flag.
- replay: rv-base-v1 handled samples successfully.

Immediate mitigation actions (done):
- platform: disable alt-llm-8q for ap-southeast-1 (Priya) — done.
- router: replayed queued fallback requests to rv-base-v1 (Marco) — limited replay succeeded.
- support: drafting customer comms for impacted routes (support-team).

Planned follow-ups and owners:
- platform (Priya): require manifest compatibility checks in rollout pipeline; block `fallback_candidate` until compat pass. Ticket: TKT-6132.
- serving/model-host (Marco): extend healthprobe to validate tokenizer_version and a light tokenization smoke test during model warmup. PR: check-tokenizer-compat (TKT-6133).
- devex (Lena): add quick runbook snippet for disabling single fallback variants and safe replays (`policy.region_fallback.<region>.disable_variant` examples).
- eng-sre (Jules): create incident playbook entry for fallback misrouting and add monitoring alert for `fallback_selection_to_unready_variant`.

Support-team: ETA for customer note? Keep it short — impacted customers in ap-southeast-1 with hosted inference/dedicated burst.

support-team: drafting: short outage + mitigation + link to incident artifacts + ETA for RCA (72h). Will post in status channel and send to account teams.

Marco: attaching grep commands and host logs to ticket (https://internal.redwood/tickets/TKT-6132). Quick grep for folks: `grep -E "tokenizer|manifest.schema|kvcache" /var/log/model-host/* | tail -n 300`

Jules: timeline for post-incident doc:
- 02:12:03Z alert triggered
- 02:12:30Z oncall ack (Jules)
- 02:13:10Z host logs confirming tokenizer_version mismatch
- 02:13:45Z platform disables alt-llm-8q for ap-southeast-1
- 02:15:00Z replay to rv-base-v1 and verification
- 02:16:30Z error rate back to baseline, incident reduced to monitoring

Lena: small note — alt-llm-8q passed unit tests but tokenizer schema bump wasn't included in rollout checklist. I'll add that to dev-checklist (TKT-6134).

Jules: ok folks, I'll draft the RCA with root cause = H1 prioritized (manifest/tokenizer incompatibility) and include H2/H3 as systemic causes. We'll defer final severity adjustment after support confirms customer reach. I'll hand off remediation tickets to Priya and Marco. I'll remain oncall for 20m for any follow-ups. Thanks. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: Incident 1825004321 -> status: mitigated -> archived to /incidents/1825004321/artifacts.
